60400.commentary: (ANa) sampavāretī'ti alaṃ alan'ti vācāya c'eva hatthavikārena ca paṭikkhipāpeti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappeti sampavāreti.

60401.meaning1: having satisfied; having satiated; having fulfilled
60401.commentary: (VINa) sampavāretvā'ti suṭṭhu pavāretvā alan'ti hatthasaññāya mukhasaññāya vacībhedena ca paṭikkhipāpetvā.

60402.commentary: (DNa) sampavāresī'ti suṭṭhu pavāresi, alaṃ alan'ti hatthasaññāya paṭikkhipāpesi.

examples.text: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo satt'āhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
atha kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū paṇītena sappipāyāsena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi. atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu.

60403.meaning2: is shaken violently, is highly affected
60403.synonym: kampati, pariphandati, pavedhati, phandati, byathati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, saṅkampati, sampakampati, saṃkampati

examples.text: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.
phassena yadā phuṭṭhassa, paridevaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, bhavañ'ca n'ābhijappeyya, bheravesu ca na sampavedheyya.
ayañ'ca dasasahassī lokadhātu saṅkampi sampakampi sampavedhi appamāṇo ca oḷāro obhāso loke pāturahosi atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.

seyyathā'pi rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. evam'evaṃ kho ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ

60407.meaning1: causes to shake; causes to quake
60407.meaning2: is caused to be shaken violently
60407.commentary: (ANa) na sampavedheyyā'ti vedhetvā pavedhetvā pātetuṃ na sakkuṇeyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

60408.meaning1: could cause to shake; could cause to quake

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya

60409.meaning1: caused to shake; caused to quake

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pād'aṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi.

60410.grammar: aor of caus of saṃ pa √vis, caus, ditrans (+acc & +acc)

examples.text: sampavesesi kho, ānanda, mātali, saṅgāhako nimiṃ rājānaṃ sudhammaṃ sabhaṃ.

60411.meaning1: (of metal) beaten; forged; wrought; (comm) washed, beaten and polished

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma nikkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

60413.meaning1: who delights; who pleases; who gladdens; who elates

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… ovādako viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnan'ti?
no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti, no parahitāya.

60416.meaning1: is glad; is happy; is thrilled; is elated; (comm) frightens
60416.commentary: (NIDD1a) sampahaṃsati kālenā'ti yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paññāpayogamandatāya vā upasamasukhānaṃ vigamena vā nirassādaṃ hoti, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭha-saṃvegavatthu-paccavekkhaṇena saṃvejeti. aṭṭha saṃvegavatthūni nāma, jātijarābyādhimaraṇāni cattāri, apāyadukkhaṃ pañcamaṃ, atīte vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ anāgate vaṭṭamūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ, paccuppanne āhārapariyeṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhan'ti. ratanattayaguṇ'ānussaraṇen'āssa pasādaṃ janeti. ayaṃ vuccati sampahaṃsati kālenā'ti.

examples.text: kāle paggaṇhati cittaṃ, niggaṇhati punāpare, sampahaṃsati kālena, kāle cittaṃ samādahe.

60420.synonym: attamana, pamudita, pamodita, pahaṭṭha, pahaṃsita, pīṇita, rata, vitta, sammudita, sukhita

examples.text: te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamanti avalokayamānā'y'eva avijahitattā.

atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo mantāṇiputto bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya.

60421.commentary: (VISM) kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti? yadāssa paññāpayogamandatāya vā upasamasukhānadhigamena vā nirassādaṃ cittaṃ hoti, tadā naṃ aṭṭha-saṃvegavatthu-paccavekkhaṇena saṃvejeti.

60422.grammar: prp of pass of saṃ pa √haṃs, pass, intrans (+instr)
60422.meaning1: being delighted; being pleased; being gladdened; being thrilled (by)
60422.meaning2: being delighted; being pleased; being gladdened; being thrilled

examples.text: tesaṃ vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādapiyamānānaṃ samuttejiyamānānaṃ sampahaṃsiyamānānaṃ nacirass'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu.

60423.meaning1: should be gladdened; should be delighted
60423.commentary: (VINt) kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti? yadāssa paññāpayogamandatāya vā upasamasukhānadhigamena vā nirassādaṃ cittaṃ hoti, tadā naṃ aṭṭha-saṃvegavatthu-paccavekkhaṇena saṃvejeti.

60424.commentary: (SNa) sampahaṃsetī'ti paṭividdhaguṇena vodāpeti jotāpeti. (ANa) sampahaṃsetī'ti paṭiladdhaguṇehi vaṇṇaṃ kathento vodāpeti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
so bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.

60425.meaning1: to delight; to please; to gladden; to thrill (somebody with)

examples.text: nappaṭibalo hoti gilānaṃ kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato gilān'upaṭṭhāko n'ālaṃ gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ.

60426.meaning1: having delighted; having pleased; having thrilled

examples.text: so taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamati. so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca muccitu'kāmo gacchati.

atha kho kassapagottassa bhikkhuno bhagavati sikkhāpadapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya bhikkhū sandassente samādapente samuttejente sampahaṃsente ahu'd'eva akkhanti ahu appaccayo, adhisallikhat'ev'āyaṃ samaṇo'ti.

60428.commentary: (DNa) sampahaṃsesī'ti sundaraṃ te kataṃ, mahārāja, dānaṃ dadamānenā'ti thutiṃ katvā kathesi.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.

60429.commentary: (DNa) siyā sampahāro'ti āvudhasampahāro sādhu na siyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: uyyodhikaṃ nāma yattha sampahāro dissati.
suṇantu bhonto mama ekavācaṃ, amhāka buddho ahu khantivādo, na hi sādhu yaṃ uttamapuggalassa, sarīrabhāge siyā sampahāro.

60430.meaning2: enveloped; sheathed; concealed; totally wrapped up

examples.text: tasmā pattapuṭass'eva, ñatvā sampākam'attano, asante n'upaseveyya, sante seveyya paṇḍito, asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatin'ti.

60432.commentary: (VINa) sūpasampāke'ti vāsagāhāpan'atthaṃ īsakaṃ majjaṃ pakkhipitvā sūpaṃ pacanti, tasmiṃ anāpatti. maṃsasampāke'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: anāpatti amajjañ'ca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasaṃ taṃ pivati, sūpasampāke, maṃsasampāke, telasampāke, āmalakaphāṇite, amajjaṃ ariṭṭhaṃ pivati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
antamaso gām'antaram'pī'ti kukkuṭasampāte gāme, gām'antare gām'antare āpatti pācittiyassa. agāmake araññe, addhayojane addhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.

60438.meaning2: happened to be; turned out to be; became

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena indasālaguhā' visamā santī samā sampādi, sambādhā santī urundā sampādi, andhakāro guhāyaṃ antaradhāyi, āloko udapādi yathā taṃ devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvena.

60442.meaning1: presses on; causes to accomplish; strives to achieve; tries to accomplish one's purpose

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.
sace tattha āgacchati so vattabbo, āvuso, kīdisaṃ te bhaṇḍan'ti? sace rūpena vā nimittena vā sampādeti dātabbaṃ, no ce sampādeti vicināhi āvuso'ti vattabbo.

60445.meaning1: to press on; to strive to achieve; to try to accomplish one's purpose
60445.meaning2: to press on; to cause to reach; to strive to achieve

examples.text: evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ. att'atthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetuṃ

so tasmiṃ ambavane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭhāna-leṇakuṭi-maṇḍap'ādīni sampādetvā bhagavato anucchavikaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ kārāpetvā ambavanaṃ aṭṭhārasahatth'ubbedhena tambapaṭṭavaṇṇena pākārena parikkhipāpetvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sacīvarabhattena santappetvā dakkhiṇ'odakaṃ pātetvā vihāraṃ niyyātesi.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāmegho sabbasassāni sampādento bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sappuriso kule jāyamāno bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya hoti, mātāpitūnaṃ atthāya hitāya sukhāya hoti, puttadārassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya hoti…

tadubhayam'pi yaṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā nirujjhati, taṃ tesaṃ appavattiṃ nibbānaṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti. tassa sampāpakaṃ ariyamaggaṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti sarasalakkhaṇapaṭivedhena yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ jāniṃ paṭivijjhin'ti evam'attho veditabbo.
dasame sīlasāro'ti sārasampāpakaṃ sīlaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

60451.meaning1: making one reach; causing to arrive at

examples.text: āyatiñ'ca nirayasampāpanena maggaṃ nirayagāminaṃ na jānāti.

60454.synonym: adhigacchati, adhigameti, anupāpuṇāti, appeti, āpajjati, pāpuṇāti, phassayati, phusati, phuseti, phussayati

examples.text: so c'assa assaddho, yāvatakaṃ saddhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya. so c'assa bahv'ābādho, yāvatakaṃ appābādhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.

atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi nagarakamhā yena medāḷupaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo tena pāyāsi. ten'eva divasāvasesena medāḷupaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamaṃ sampāpuṇi. yena ārāmo tena pāyāsi.
sakko devarājā, kiṃ no sādhāraṇena rajjenā'ti asure dibbapānaṃ pāyetvā matte samāne pādesu gāhāpetvā sinerupabbatapāde khipāpesi. te asurabhavanam'eva sampāpuṇiṃsu.

60458.meaning2: having reached, having attained, having met with

sampāpesi kho, ānanda, mātali, saṅgāhako nimiṃ rājānaṃ sudhammaṃ sabhaṃ.

60460.meaning1: is able to answer; can continue
60460.commentary: (DNa) na sampāyantī'ti sampādetvā kathetuṃ na sakkonti. (SNPa) na sampāyantī'ti na sampādenti.

examples.text: idaṃ pan'āyasmā, kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatā'ti, iti puṭṭho na sampāyissati.
evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.

60461.commentary: (MNa) sampāyatī'ti… cariyaṃ puṭṭho sampādetvā kathetuṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu codito codakena apadāne na sampāyati, ayam'pi dhammo dovacassakaraṇo.

60462.commentary: (MNa) na sampāyāsī'ti sampādetvā kathetuṃ n'āsakkhi, yathā taṃ bālaputhujjano.

examples.text: kin'ti pana te, aggivessana, cittabhāvanā sutā'ti? cittabhāvanāya kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavatā puṭṭho samāno na sampāyāsi.
